scientific_boundary.fast_effect: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION: positive current effect proportional to contact count
scientific_boundary.teacher: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION: inactive throughout this gate; no DAN identity
scientific_boundary.action: ENGINEERING OVERLAY: fixed inverse bilateral MBON-m1 spike-count thresholds

update_order: deliver arrivals at or before tick
schedule outgoing events using emission-time weight

encoder.group_rule: sort the 88 KC source IDs ascending and partition into eight non-overlapping contiguous groups using quotient/remainder allocation

controllability_intervention.only_varied_quantity_within_configuratio: all candidate KC -> MBON-m1 weights multiplied by the declared factor

readout.neural_measure: bilateral MBON-m1 spike count during the fixed response window
readout.monotonic_direction: lower MBON-m1 count gives equal or greater action drive

family.configuration_order: lexicographic in contact effect, tau_m, threshold, pulse

per_configuration_pass_rule.zero_drive: no spikes, interface disarmed, finite state, bounded queues
per_configuration_pass_rule.cue_activation: all eight cues produce at least one spike in every intended KC
per_configuration_pass_rule.starting_activity: factor 1.0 produces at least one bilateral MBON-m1 spike in at least six of eight states
per_configuration_pass_rule.effect_size: factor 0.2 reduces bilateral MBON-m1 spike count by at least 30 percent versus factor 1.0 in at least six of eight states
per_configuration_pass_rule.monotonicity: responses are non-increasing as weights decrease in at least seven of eight states, with no reversal greater than one spike
per_configuration_pass_rule.action_transition: at one frozen threshold, action sets are nested as weights decrease; at least three states change from no action at factor 1.0 to action at a lower factor; the factor 0.2 action set contains two through six states

family_pass_rule.axis_coverage: qualifiers span at least two values on every varied axis
family_pass_rule.face_adjacency: configurations differ by one adjacent value on exactly one axis
family_pass_rule.nominal_selection: coordinate-wise median of the largest qualifying component; ties use lower contact scale then lower pulse

outcome_policy.pass: write a nominal electrical model and permit the local-plasticity gate
outcome_policy.fail: retire this frozen L1R-E electrical abstraction before plasticity
outcome_policy.inconclusive: repair execution only; do not alter parameter values or pass rules
